_format: Each game: slug (matches a build's `game` in versions.json and its builds/<slug>/ dir), name, one-line description (from the source README), repo (owner/name), project (dir in the repo holding project.godot), scene (main-scene override as res:// path, or null for the project's run/main_scene).

games.name: Zeigote
games.description: A multiplayer day/night base-building survival game about a nanobot organism called the Zeigote.

games.name: Tower Defense
games.description: A small 3D greybox tower defense game that doubles as a Godot 4 engine benchmark: enemies walk a Path3D in 20 waves, you build Gun, Cannon and Frost towers on a grid, upgrade them, sell them and pick their targets.

games.name: Gears Clone
games.description: A Gears of War-style third-person cover shooter benchmark: shoulder camera, aiming, hitscan, crouch, snap-to-cover and an ammo/reload HUD.

games.name: Minecraft Clone
games.description: Smooth-terrain sandbox benchmark in Godot 4.7.2, now set in a 10,000 BC Mesopotamian desert ring: dunes, palms, oases and hills with caves. Chop wood, break stone, sculpt the sand.
